boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UIC study environments spanning Student Center East and the university libraries.

cards.title: Circle Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, first-floor tower
cards.notes: Take the tower elevator to the first floor, then settle into the Circle Lounge for an indoor study session during building hours.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor Student Center East lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers identifies Circle Lounge on the first floor tower of Student Center East and says it is open during building hours.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Located on the first-floor tower; open during Student Center East building hours.

cards.title: Montgomery Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second-floor tower
cards.notes: Use the second-floor tower lounge when you want a defined Student Center East stop; confirm building hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor tower lounge in Student Center East.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers lists Montgomery Lounge on the second floor tower of Student Center East and states it is open during building hours.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Located on the second-floor tower; open during Student Center East building hours.

cards.title: Pier Room
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor beside Dunkin’
cards.notes: Find this room beside Dunkin’ Donuts on the second floor; microwaves are available if you are planning a longer work block.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor study room with microwaves nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers places the Pier Room on Student Center East’s second floor beside Dunkin’ Donuts and notes that microwaves are available.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours.

cards.title: East Terrace
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor
cards.notes: From the second-floor escalators, turn right toward the Inner Circle and use the left entrance to reach this terrace study area.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor terrace reached from the Inner Circle side.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers locates East Terrace on the second floor of Student Center East and provides the route from the escalators.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours.

cards.title: West Terrace
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor
cards.notes: From the second-floor escalators, turn left toward the Inner Circle and use the right entrance to access this terrace study area.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor terrace on the west side of the Inner Circle.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers locates West Terrace on the second floor of Student Center East and provides the route from the escalators.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours.

cards.title: Inner Circle
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor
cards.notes: Walk behind the second-floor escalators to reach the Inner Circle; use its microwaves if you need a practical break between tasks.
cards.short_summary: A central second-floor Student Center East study area.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers identifies the Inner Circle on the second floor of Student Center East and notes that microwaves are available.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours.

cards.title: Commuter Center
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor near Circle Burger
cards.notes: Enter the Inner Circle from the second-floor escalators and take the door near Circle Burger for quiet individual study areas.
cards.short_summary: A designated Commuter Center with quiet individual areas.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers states that the Commuter Center has quiet individual study areas and locates it on Student Center East’s second floor near Circle Burger.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours.

cards.title: Circle Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Richard J. Daley Library, first floor
cards.notes: Choose this enclosed first-floor reading room when a designated quiet setting fits your work; follow library conduct and current building access rules.
cards.short_summary: An enclosed quiet room in Daley Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Library identifies the Circle Reading Room as an enclosed first-floor room in Daley Library that is designated as a quiet space.
cards.source_title: Accessibility Services | University Library | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Daley Library is open to the public; see current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Daley Library Level 3 Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Daley Library Level 3 Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Richard J. Daley Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Head to Level 3 for a map-designated quiet study area, and keep sound low so the shared floor remains useful for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study area on Daley Library’s third level.
cards.evidence_claim: The Daley Library map identifies quiet or silent study areas on Level 3.
cards.access_notes: Daley Library is open to the public; see current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Room 107 Quiet Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Library of the Health Sciences-Chicago, first floor
cards.notes: Use the large enclosed Room 107 reading room for quiet work on the first floor, checking the library’s current access guidance before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A large enclosed quiet room at LHS Chicago.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Library identifies Room 107 as a large enclosed quiet reading room on the first floor of the Library of the Health Sciences.
cards.source_title: Accessibility Services | University Library | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: LHS Chicago is generally open to the public Monday through Saturday; Sunday access has additional visitor procedures.
